english.title: Fail to comply with a planning contravention notice with 21 days of service - Town and Country Planning Act 1990
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a requirement of a planning contravention notice within twenty one days of its service on you by **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL PLANNING AUTHORITY ..) in pursuance of section 171C of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 in that **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171D(1) and (4) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

english.notes:
(i) Section 171D(2) of the Act provides that an offender may be charged by reference to any day or longer period of time and he/she may be convicted of a second or subsequent offence under section 171D(1) by reference to any period of time following the preceding conviction for such an offence.
(ii) Section 171D(3) of the Act provides, "It shall be a defence for a person charged with an offence under subsection (1) to prove that he had a reasonable excuse for failing to comply with the requirement".
